name: "Beef Stroganoff" Mushroom Burgers with Honey-Parsley Roasted Carrots

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 medium carrots
3 lb cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim carrots. Slice in half crosswise, then lengthwise into ½-inch thick sticks. Place in a large bowl along with oil, honey, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide carrots between two baking sheet pans and spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until fork-tender, about 20 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, mince half the mushrooms and place in the reserved bowl. Thinly slice remaining mushrooms, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
Add beef, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the minced mushrooms; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the mixture into 6 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add the burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes. Flip patties and continue to cook until cooked through, 5 minutes more. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to medium heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion begins to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Sprinkle flour into the skillet and stir to combine. Add broth and bring to a simmer; continue to cook, stirring often, until the sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp all-purpose flour
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the sauce has thickened, remove from the heat. Add yogurt, Worcestershire, and half the parsley (reserving the rest for the carrots); stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the carrots are done, remove from the oven, sprinkle with reserved parsley, and toss to combine.
Place bottom half of each bun on a plate, then top with burgers and mushroom sauce. Close with the top half of the bun and serve with roasted carrots on the side. Enjoy!
